title: Climbed swap orders on reordered exclusion sums for certified κ = 4.129418696e-5
body:
Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses:

$$T(n) = O(n (\log n)^{1 - \kappa}),\qquad \kappa = \frac{4129418696}{10^{14}} = 4.129418696 \times 10^{-5} > 2^{-15}.$$

This is **+0.13469% above PR #49** (`4123863984/10^14`) and **+0.26206% above PR #48** (`411862541/10^13`). The exact rational bit saving is:
$$a_{\text{bit}} = \frac{165183569}{4 \times 10^{12}} = \frac{4129589225}{10^{14}} = 4.129589225 \times 10^{-5}.$$

---

### Comparative Benchmark

| Dimension / Metric | PR #48 (`@chafreaky`) | PR #49 (`@rohanarun`) | This PR | Improvement vs PR #49 |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **$h=23$ Scratch Roles $R_{23}$** | $36,432$ | $36,382$ | **$36,297$** | **$-85$ roles** ($-135$ vs PR #48) |
| **$h=23$ Matched Carriers** | $6,010$ | $6,077$ | **$6,202$** | **$+125$ matches** ($+192$ vs PR #48) |
| **$h=25$ Scratch Roles $R_{25}$** | $48,329$ | $48,255$ | **$48,201$** | **$-54$ roles** ($-128$ vs PR #48) |
| **$h=25$ Matched Carriers** | $7,715$ | $7,809$ | **$7,903$** | **$+94$ matches** ($+188$ vs PR #48) |
| **Total Scratch Roles Saved** | Baseline | $124$ roles | **$263$ roles** | **$+139$ roles saved** |
| **Total Wire Count $W$** | $177,530,859$ | $177,284,805$ | **$176,993,671$** | **$-291,134$ wires** ($-537,188$ vs PR #48) |
| **Bit Saving $a_{\text{bit}}$** | $\frac{411880455}{10^{13}}$ | $\frac{4124034054}{10^{14}}$ | **$\frac{4129589225}{10^{14}}$** | **$+0.13469\%$** |
| **Certified Exponent $\kappa$** | $\frac{411862541}{10^{13}}$ | $\frac{4123863984}{10^{14}}$ | **$\frac{4129418696}{10^{14}}$** | **$+0.13469\%$** |

---

### What Changed

Starting from PR #48 and PR #49's base orders, we executed a multi-round greedy hill-climb across all candidate adjacent-swap bits for both `total()` calls (`tbits`) and `vector()` calls (`vbits`):
- **$h=23$**: $21$ total swaps + $13$ vector swaps ($R_{23}: 36,382 \to 36,297$, matched carriers $6,077 \to 6,202$).
- **$h=25$**: $12$ total swaps + $21$ vector swaps ($R_{25}: 48,255 \to 48,201$, matched carriers $7,809 \to 7,903$).
- Wire count reduced by **$291,134$ wires** below PR #49 (and **$537,188$ wires** below PR #48) down to $W = 176,993,671$.
- Pinned optimal carrier matchings regenerated with `min_weight_full_bipartite_matching`.

---

### Verification

All checks pass with zero discrepancies via `make climbed-48-verify`:
- `producer.py`: Replays both dimensions ($h=23, 25$) with scalar identity, dense audit, independent recount, and full physical timeline/dirty basis in both orientations. Zero CRT modular disagreements across all 5,332 $h=23$ and 7,162 $h=25$ matrices.
- `witness.py`: Validates all 47 strict inequalities, 7 positive margins, rejects next grid points ($+10^{-14}$), and excludes predecessor networks (PR #40 through PR #48).
- `tests/test_climbed_48.py`: 5/5 unit tests pass (`OK`).

```sh
make climbed-48-verify
```
